user.title: Set up Tuya BLE
user.description: Pick the Tuya BLE device you want to add.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description:
This device only accepts a connection from someone who already knows its device id and local key, and it never broadcasts either. Sign in to the Tuya account the device is bound to and they are read from it, or enter them yourself.

The first reading arrives the next time the device announces itself, which can take several minutes — until then the sensors stay unknown. The credentials are only checked then, so a wrong local key shows up as a request to re-authenticate rather than an error during setup.

account.title: Sign in to Tuya
account.description:
Enter the Tuya app account this device is bound to. The credentials are used once, to read the device id and the local key of {name}, and are not stored.

The country code is the calling code the account was registered with, and the region is the data centre it lives in.

manual.title: Set up {name}
manual.description: Enter the device id and the local key this device uses. Both are listed for the device in your Tuya account. A device that is bound to a Tuya account does not broadcast what it is, so pick the product as well.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tuya BLE
reauth_confirm.description:
The device stopped answering with the stored local key. Re-pair it in the Tuya app, then read the current credentials from your Tuya account or enter them yourself.

As with the initial setup, the new credentials are only checked the next time the device announces itself.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tuya BLE
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for this device.

error.account_busy: The Tuya account turned the sign-in away, which it does after a few attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Tuya account. Check the region and try again.
error.device_not_in_account: This account does not list the device seen at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The Tuya account rejected these credentials.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter the device id from your Tuya account.
error.invalid_local_key: The local key is too short to be valid.
error.unknown: Failed to read the Tuya account.
error.unsupported_product: The account says this device is a product the integration does not support.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported Tuya BLE device was found nearby.
abort.not_supported: This device is not supported by the integration.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device does not match the one this entry was set up with.

init.title: Tuya BLE options
init.description: The device is read at most once per interval, the next time it announces itself.

unsupported_product.message: Product {product_id} is no longer supported by this integration.
